dedupe_keys.name: canadian emergency department wait times erstat

description: ERstat publishes an archived snapshot of emergency-department waiting-time estimates from official Canadian provincial and regional feeds. Zenodo provides hospital, hourly-wait and typical-pattern CSVs plus a README under CC BY-NC 4.0. The README reports 224 departments in eight provinces from 11 March through 1 September 2026, with about 8.3 million collected point-in-time readings. Hourly medians, minima, maxima and observation counts use UTC; recurring weekday-hour patterns use local time. These series can calibrate service-delay and patient-arrival scenarios in emergency-department capacity simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the ERstat archive. Coverage excludes provinces and territories without a public live feed. A limitation is that the upstream wait metric, update frequency and availability vary by hospital; most values estimate time to physician, not total treatment duration. This is an archived historical snapshot, not a live operational estimate. No CSV was downloaded, and feed quality was not independently checked.
